text:
mike: ok folks quick poll: should we veto javier's Monday night blockbuster trade? fair warning: it would tip our league.
anna: post the trade again? i missed the thread.
javier: here I sent D'Angelo and a bench stash for a week of Christian Wood. desperate times after injuries.
zoe: oof that feels heavy. mike do we have a veto rule for parity?
mike: rule is majority veto within 24h if >60% think it's collusive. open to vibes.
tyler: i'm leaning no veto if both sides consent. leaves manager autonomy.
anna: i'm on the fence. javier, was there prior side-talk with the other manager?
javier: nope, pure panic trade. i cried in the DMs for 3 minutes before pushing accept.
zoe: anon poll might help. opsbot can you spin up a quick reaction poll: "Veto Javier trade?" yes/no/abstain
opsbot: Poll created by zoe: "Veto Javier trade?" Options: 1) Yes - protect parity 2) No - let managers trade 3) Abstain. React with :one:, :two:, :three:.
mike: putting :one: for now. equity first.
tyler: :two: let chaos reign
anna: :one: but berried in doubt
javier: :three: (i voted abstain for moral support)
opsbot: Poll closed. Results: Yes - 3 votes, No - 1 vote, Abstain - 2 votes. Outcome: Veto passes.
javier: well that's embarrassing. i'll offer a reversal and a donut to the commish.
zoe: donuts change everything. also shoutout to anna for setting up the watch party this weekend  legendary snacks last time.
anna: thanks! bringing buffalo tofu bites this time.
tyler: i'll bring the thermos of questionable coffee. someone remind me not to drink it before the 4th quarter.
mike: finals plan: watch at 6pm in lounge, bets limited to bragging rights. see y'all then. :trophy:
